reference_model: independent random/random images with iid uniform pixels
sidedness: absolute deviation from exact null expectation
zero_level: shared independent null-validation sample in both families
boundary_rule: lexicographic (integer score, independent U(0,1)) exceeds kth largest calibration pair; k=alpha*(calibration_size+1)
stream_convention: NumPy PCG64 seeded by SeedSequence([root_seed, stage, family, level]); stage 1 for images and stage 2 for tie-breakers; family 0 calibration, 1 null validation, 2 identity, 3 horizontal copy
marginal_intervals: Wilson binomial intervals conditional on the realized calibration bank
paired_difference_intervals: conservative exact intervals by Bonferroni combination of 97.5 percent Clopper-Pearson intervals for discordant outcome probabilities
scope: simulation study only; no selection of alternative strengths after observing outcomes
